title: Rav Kahana bar Matityah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 8b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.8b.7), according to the reading of Dikdukei Soferim, and our reading there is "bar Meniyumi," but the reading of the Yuchasin was "bar Mattityah," and so it is in the Or Zarua, siman 114; and in [Menachot 66b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.66b.11): "Rav Kahana bar Tachlifa objected to Rav Kahana bar Mattityah."[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Eruvin gives a chain through Rav Kahana bar Minyomi. Menachot has bar Mattityah in parentheses in the objection by Rav Kahana bar Tachlifa. Hyman reports other editions in support of Mattityah, while [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2297&lang=en) argues that the patronymic arose from a textual error.
